name: Florian Müller
abstract_title: The Geometry of Coherence: Recursive Holography and Contractive Dynamics of Conscious Experience
abstract: A fundamental question in consciousness research is why conscious experience typically remains coherent and unified despite pervasive neural noise and perturbations. We propose Recursive Holography as a substrate-independent stability principle for emergent order in complex systems, yielding testable predictions.
